house.description: Bolder Options funding provided for youth programming, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to Bolder Options for youth programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+BOLDER OPTIONS YOUTH MENTORING; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Bolder Options Youth Mentoring Program to provide disadvantaged youth ages 12 through 22 with intensive one-to-one wellness, goal setting, and academic-focused mentorship; programming that teaches life and job-seeking skills; career and college achievement coaches; and connections to employment, job training, and education opportunities. The grant must serve youth in the Bolder Options program in the Twin Cities and Rochester, Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to Bolder Options for youth programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BOLDER OPTIONS YOUTH MENTORING; APPROPRIATION.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Bolder Options Youth Mentoring Program to provide disadvantaged youth ages 12 through 22 with intensive one-to-one wellness, goal setting, and academic-focused mentorship; programming that teaches life and job-seeking skills; career and college achievement coaches; and connections to employment, job training, and education opportunities. The grant must serve youth in the Bolder Options program in the Twin Cities and Rochester, Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Bolder Options Youth Mentoring Program to provide disadvantaged youth ages 12 through 22 with intensive one-to-one wellness, goal setting, and academic-focused mentorship; programming that teaches life and job-seeking skills; career and college achievement coaches; and connections to employment, job training, and education opportunities. The grant must serve youth in the Bolder Options program in the Twin Cities and Rochester, Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation.
